blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 导言和有关工作

blocks.en: 1.1 Theoretical Grounding and Student Discourse
blocks.zh: 1.1 理论定位和学生演讲

blocks.en: Human tutoring has long been shown to support mathematics learning among K–12 students Borchers and others (2026) , creating opportunities for sustained, responsive interaction around students’ emerging understanding. The ICAP (Interactive–Constructive–Active–Passive) framework explains why such interaction matters, proposing that learning deepens as students move toward constructive and interactive engagement Chi and Wylie (2014) . This perspective positions student discourse as rich evidence from which learning analytics systems can infer properties of learners’ understanding and difficulty.
blocks.zh: 长期以来,人类辅导被证明可以支持K-12学生Borchers等人(2026年)的数学学习,创造机会,围绕学生的新理解进行持续、反应迅速的互动。 Interactive–Construction–Active–Passive)框架解释了这种互动之所以重要的原因,提议随着学生走向建设性和互动性参与的Chi和Wylie(2014年)而加深学习. 这种观点将学生的言论视为丰富的证据,从中学习分析系统可以推断学生理解和困难的特性。

blocks.en: Characterizing student struggle is paramount. In the United States, for example, the Education Scorecard describes mathematics achievement below levels observed a decade earlier in 70% of school districts Dewey and others (2026) . Addressing such declines requires understanding not only whether students are struggling, but the nature of that struggle as it unfolds. Student–tutor discourse can reveal distinct failure modes : the underlying reasons a student produces an incorrect response or cannot complete a learning task. Distinguishing these modes is critical, as different sources of difficulty often call for different instructional responses. Traditionally, doing so required trained human annotators to interpret discourse manually and label instances of struggle—a time- and resource-intensive process that limits analysis at scale Garg and others (2024) .
blocks.zh: 突出学生斗争的特点至关重要。 例如,在美国,教育计分卡描述数学成绩低于十年前在70%的校区杜威等校(2026年)观察到的水平. 解决这种衰退不仅需要了解学生是否在挣扎,还需要了解这场斗争在进行中的性质。 学生的演讲可以揭示不同的失败模式:学生产生错误反应或无法完成学习任务的根本原因。 区分这些模式至关重要,因为不同的困难来源往往需要不同的教学反应。 传统上,这样做需要训练有素的人类注释员手动解释言论,并标出斗争的事例——这是一个耗费时间和资源的过程,限制了Garg等规模(2024年)的分析。

blocks.en: 1.2 LLM Labeling in Learning Analytics
blocks.zh: 1.2 LLM 学习分析中的标签

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have consequently become attractive for transforming conversational learning traces into scalable representations of learners’ understanding and difficulty. Recent work has used LLMs to code tutoring and classroom discourse Garg and others (2024) , generate labels supporting knowledge tracing Scarlatos et al. (2025) , and conduct qualitative coding across educational contexts Liu et al. (2025) ; while other approaches retain humans in the loop Xavier and others (2026) . However, evidence that LLMs can replicate human annotation remains mixed; Vanacore and Kizilcec (2026) conclude that “unscaffolded LLMs are not yet sufficiently reliable to replace human coders for complex instructional constructs.”
blocks.zh: 因此,大型语言模型(LLMS)对将对话学习痕迹转化为学生理解和困难的可扩展表述具有吸引力。 最近的工作利用LLMS进行代码辅导和课堂演讲 Garg等(2024),生成支持追踪Scarlatos等(2025)知识的标签,并在教育背景中进行定性编码;Liu等(2025),而其他方法则将人类保留在环Xavier等(2026)中. 然而,关于LLMS可以复制人类注释的证据仍然混杂;Vanacore和Kizilcec(2026年)的结论是,“没有脚手脚的LLMS还不足以取代人类编码器进行复杂的教学构造。 “

blocks.en: Learning analytics researchers have therefore begun to scrutinize how such annotation should be evaluated and improved. Xu and others (2026) distinguish task ambiguity from model-specific annotation error; Borchers et al. (2026) show that conventional reliability estimates may inadequately characterize LLM scoring in longitudinal learning settings; and Ahtisham and others (2026) use self- and cross-model verification to improve LLM coding of tutoring discourse. Together, these studies demonstrate the promise of LLMs for scalable annotation while underscoring the importance of validating whether their labels faithfully reflect the constructs being measured.
blocks.zh: 因此,学习分析研究者已开始仔细研究如何评价和改进这种说明。 徐等(2026年)将任务模糊与模型特有注释错误区分开来; Borchers等(2026年)表明,常规可靠性估计在纵向学习环境中对LLM评分的描述可能不充分;而Ahtisham等(2026年)则使用自建和跨模型校验方法来改进导读语句的LLM编码. 这些研究共同表明,LLMs对可缩放的注解很有希望,同时强调必须验证其标签是否忠实地反映了所测量的构造。

blocks.en: A recent and related development is the use of multiple models as evaluators. Fonteles et al. (2026b) compare multiple LLMs for multimodal classroom analysis, and Zhu and others (2026) incorporate LLM-enriched Q-matrices into cognitive diagnosis. Thapa Magar and others (2026) , however, show that generative models can produce coherent representations of learning strategies that diverge from the actual patterns in authentic learner data; and other studies employ LLM-generated labels or evaluations without human validation Misiejuk and others (2025) .
blocks.zh: 最近的一个相关发展是使用多种模型作为评价员。 Fonteles等 (2026b)比较多种LLMs进行多模式课堂分析,而Zhu等 (2026)将LLM-浓缩Q-matrices纳入认知诊断. 然而,Thapa Magar等人(2026年)表明,基因模型可以产生与真实学习者数据中的实际模式不同的连贯的学习战略表现;其他研究则使用LLM生成的标签或评价,而无需人类验证Misiejuk等人(2025年).

blocks.en: 1.3 Detecting Student Failure Modes from Discourse
blocks.zh: 1.3 从演讲中检测学生失败模式

blocks.en: Prior discourse-based learning analytics has used student interaction data to characterize learning-relevant states and processes, but diagnosing the specific reasoning error underlying an individual incorrect response remains comparatively underexplored. Suraworachet and others (2024) detect cognitive, metacognitive, emotional, and technical challenge moments from collaborative discourse; Booth and others (2024) analyze accountable talk in tutoring; Liu and others (2026) connect instructional discourse with engagement and performance; Snyder and others (2024) and Zhang and others (2026) detect socially shared regulation processes; and Güres and others (2026) examine diagnostic reasoning and cognitive bias. These studies operate primarily at the level of broader behavioral, interactional, or challenge constructs rather than diagnosing the specific failure that resulted in an incorrect response. Authentic spoken tutoring dialogue makes this finer-grained inference difficult, as such discourse is often disfluent, interrupted, incomplete, and affected by transcription and diarization errors. Distinguishing specific failure modes may therefore require inference about learner reasoning that is only indirectly expressed in the dialogue.
blocks.zh: 先前基于语句的学习分析方法曾用学生交互数据来描述与学习相关的状态和过程,但对于个别不正确反应背后的具体推理错误的诊断仍然相对缺乏探讨. Suraworachet等(2024年)从合作谈话中检测认知,元认知,情感,以及技术方面的挑战时刻;Booth等(2024年)分析辅导中负责任的谈话;刘等(2026年)将教学谈话与参与和表现联系起来;Snyder等(2024年)和张等(2026年)检测出社会共有的调控过程;Güres等(2026年)考察诊断推理和认知偏好. 这些研究主要在更广泛的行为,互动,或挑战构造层面进行,而不是诊断导致错误反应的具体失败. 真实的口语辅导对话使得这种更细微的推断变得困难,因为这种论述往往不流畅,被打断,不完整,并且受到抄写和分化错误的影响. 因此,区分具体失败模式可能需要对学习者的推理进行推论,这种推理只在对话中间接表达.

blocks.en: Together, this leaves an important question unresolved for learning analytics: whether agreement across LLM families provides evidence of valid discourse interpretation, or whether shared model biases produce consensus around the same error. This has been underexplored for fine-grained diagnosis of student difficulty from authentic tutoring dialogue, including which learner states LLMs systematically over- or under-attribute and whether those biases recur across model families.
blocks.zh: 两者加在一起,给学习分析留下了一个尚未解决的重要问题:LLM家族之间的协议是否提供了有效言论解释的证据,或者共同模式偏见是否围绕同一错误形成共识. 从真正的辅导对话中,对学生困难的精细诊断,包括哪些学习者系统地指出法学硕士课程过多或不足,以及这些偏见是否在模范家庭中重复。

blocks.en: 1.4 Present Study and Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.4 本研究报告和贡献

blocks.en: In this exploratory study, we examine whether agreement among LLMs from three contemporary model families provides a valid basis for labeling student failure modes in authentic K–12 mathematics tutoring dialogue. We study five failure modes (see Section 2.1 )---uncertainty, misattribution, operator selection, conceptual gap, and procedural slip---derived from an operational codebook used by Third Space Learning 1 1 1 https://thirdspacelearning.com/ supporting over 196,000 students across the United States and United Kingdom. We compare labels from three models (one per family) with an adjudicated human reference set, quantify human–LLM and cross-model agreement, and analyze where and how model errors occur. We find a striking divergence between consensus and validity: while LLMs agree strongly with each other ( κ = .755 \kappa=.755 – .781 .781 ), their agreement with the human consensus is substantially lower ( κ = .524 \kappa=.524 – .597 .597 ), with models prone to over-inferring conceptual gaps across failure modes.
blocks.zh: 在这项探索性研究中,我们审查三个当代模范家庭的LLMs之间的协议是否为在真正的K-12数学辅导对话中给学生失败模式贴上标签提供了一个有效的基础。 我们研究了5种失败模式(见第2.1节) -- -- 不确定、分配不当、操作者选择、概念上的差距以及从第三次空间学习1 1 1 https://thirdspacelearning.com/支助美国和联合王国各地196 000多名学生使用的操作编码本中产生的程序失误。 我们把三个模型的标签(每个家庭一个)与裁定的人类参考集进行比较,量化人类-LLM和跨模型协议,并分析模型出错的地点和方式。 我们发现共识和有效性之间有显著的分歧:虽然LLMs相互强烈认同(ob = 755\kappa = 755 – 781 – 781),但他们对人类共识的认同程度却低得多(ob = 524\kappa = 524 – 597 597),模型容易在各种失败模式中过度推论出概念上的差距.

blocks.en: These results contribute to learning analytics in three ways. First, they provide empirical evidence that cross-model consensus should not substitute for human validation when LLMs infer complex learner constructs. Second, they identify systematic failure patterns that reveal where automated interpretation of student discourse is most vulnerable, with implications for LLM-generated labels in operational learning systems. Third, they foreground construct validity as a methodological requirement for scalable LLM-assisted annotation, showing that high agreement among models can reflect shared misinterpretation rather than faithful inference about learner reasoning. In learning analytics, consensus is not sufficient evidence of validity—particularly when the resulting labels may shape how real students are understood and supported.
blocks.zh: 这些成果有助于在三个方面学习分析。 首先,它们提供了经验证据,证明在LLMs推断复杂的学习者构造时,跨模型共识不应取而代之的是人类验证. 其次,它们找出了系统故障模式,揭示了学生话语的自动解释在哪些地方最为脆弱,对业务学习系统中LLM生成的标签产生影响. 第三,它们前地构建有效性,作为可伸缩的LLM辅助注释的方法要求,表明模型之间的高度一致可以反映共同的误解,而不是对学习者推理的忠实推论. 在学习分析学时,共识不足以证明有效性——特别是当由此产生的标签可能决定真正的学生如何得到理解和支持时。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: This study examines three aspects of LLM-based failure-mode diagnosis: (1) alignment with human judgments; (2) consistency across models; and (3) the failure modes and error patterns that account for the largest divergences from human interpretation. Practitioner reactions appear in the Discussion as an informal validity check, not a formal finding.
blocks.zh: 本研究研究了基于LLM的故障模式诊断的三个方面:(1) 与人类判断保持一致;(2) 模型之间的一致性;和(3) 与人类解释差异最大的故障模式和出错模式. 从业人员的反应在讨论中出现的是非正式的有效性检查,而不是正式的结论。

blocks.en: 2.1 Tutoring Platform and Failure-Mode Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 2.1 指导平台和失败模式分类学

blocks.en: Dialogue data are drawn from a Third Space Learning dataset of transcribed tutor–student interactions from a K–12 mathematics tutoring platform comprising 22,821 tutoring sessions (each with one or more learning objectives, or LOs) and 35,072 graded student responses (one per LO) between November 2024 and July 2025. Tutoring sessions were conducted virtually, with a tutor and student working synchronously through a shared screen on mathematics problems and discussing the student’s reasoning; the resulting dialogue was recorded via the tutoring platform, then transcribed and diarized into tutor and student turns using Deepgram. Each LO is automatically marked complete once the tutor is satisfied with the student’s understanding and advances to the next LO; a session’s final LO is manually marked complete or incomplete by the tutor at the session’s close. The corpus captures naturally occurring instructional dialogue rather than responses elicited solely for research.
blocks.zh: 对话数据取自从K-12数学辅导平台转来的第三套空间学习教官-学生互动数据集,包括2024年11月至2025年7月期间的22 821个辅导会(每个辅导会都有一个或多个学习目标,或联络处)和35 072个年级学生答复(每个联络处一个)。 辅导课程实际上通过一个数学问题共享屏幕和讨论学生的推理同步进行;由此产生的对话是通过辅导平台录制的,然后通过Deepgram转录和扩展成为辅导员和学生转会。 每个联络处在辅导员对学生的理解和向下一个联络处的推进感到满意后,自动标记完成;课程的最后联络处由辅导员在课程结束时手动标记完成或不完整。 调查体记录了自然发生的教学对话,而不是仅仅为研究而做出的反应。

blocks.en: The study’s five failure-mode classes are operational analytic constructs derived from the platform’s diagnostic codebook and applied through an ordered decision procedure (Table 1 ), with a sixth label, not applicable , used when an item cannot be classified due to insufficient information in the dialogue. The platform supports more than 196,000 students across over 4,200 schools in the United States and United Kingdom and has delivered 2.29 million tutoring sessions.
blocks.zh: 该研究的五个故障模式类别是运行分析构件,取自平台的诊断密码本,通过命令的决定程序加以应用(表1),如果某一项因对话中的信息不足而无法分类,则使用第六个标签,不适用。 该平台为美国和联合王国4200多所学校的196,000多名学生提供支持,并提供了229万个辅导课程。

blocks.en: Table 1: Failure-mode taxonomy, checked in the order shown; the first matching class is taken.
blocks.zh: 表1:失败模式分类法,按所示顺序检查;采用第一个匹配类.

blocks.en: This study is a secondary analysis of de-identified, third-party tutoring transcripts. The transcript analysis was conducted in accordance with Cornell University’s institutional review board requirements. Our findings concern the validity of LLM-based failure-mode classification rather than downstream learning outcomes. Because invalid labels can distort downstream learning analytics, establishing measurement validity is a prerequisite to their use.
blocks.zh: 本研究是对去身份识别的第三方辅导笔录的二级分析. 记录分析是根据康奈尔大学机构审查委员会的要求进行的。 我们的调查结果涉及基于LLM的故障模式分类的有效性,而不是下游学习结果。 由于无效的标签可以扭曲下游的学习分析,因此建立测量有效性是其使用的先决条件.

blocks.en: 2.2 Data Processing and Validation
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据处理和验证

blocks.en: We randomly sampled 5,000 de-identified transcripts containing student responses tied to an incomplete LO, localized to that learning-objective segment within the session (termed “localized segments”). Localization (i.e., identifying the specific portion of the transcript containing the incorrect student response) used an LLM-based pass (Claude Sonnet 5) to identify the tutor’s setup question, the corresponding graded student response, and, where present, the tutor’s subsequent confirmation or correction within each learning-objective segment; this graded response served as the target for failure-mode classification. Data-quality screening removed 1,146 sampled error moments (22.9%), primarily due to diarization error or unreliable localization. The resulting 3,854-item pool consists of graded responses, each embedded in its own localized segment, for which failure-mode localization and speaker-attribution checks passed.
blocks.zh: 我们随机抽取了5,000份非识别记录片,其中包含学生对不完整联络处的答复,这些记录片是本地化的,与会内学习目标部分(称为“本地化部分”)有关。 本地化(即识别包含不正确的学生响应的笔录中的特定部分)使用LLM-基于的通关(Claude Sonnet 5)来识别导师的设置问题,相应的分级学生响应,如果有的话,导师随后在每个学习-目标部分中的确认或校正;这种分级响应作为失败模式分类的目标. 数据质量筛选移除了1,146个抽样错误瞬间(22.9%),这主要是由于分化错误或不可靠的本地化. 结果的3,854-物品库包括分级的响应,每个响应都嵌入到自己的本地化部分中,对于这些响应,故障模式本地化和扬声器归属检查通过.

blocks.en: Of these, 330 were randomly sampled and reserved for iterative codebook and prompt refinement, including revisions to codebook decision rules and few-shot examples. Following a human-in-the-loop, error-analysis-driven prompt engineering procedure Cohn et al. (2025) , the codebook and prompt were iteratively refined over multiple rounds ( ≈ 10 \approx 10 ), with revisions motivated by review of disagreements between LLM predictions and human judgments. Each revision was evaluated on newly drawn, disjoint holdouts rather than items used to motivate the change, reducing the risk of overfitting the annotation scheme or prompt to previously observed cases. None of these 330 development items appeared in the final adjudicated human reference set (discussed shortly) used for analysis in this paper, preserving a fully disjoint evaluation sample. The Supplementary Materials 2 2 2 https://github.com/claytoncohn/LAK27_Supplementary_Materials document the resulting decision rules, worked examples, and refinement process in full.
blocks.zh: 其中,有330个被随机抽取,保留用于迭代代码本和即时改进,包括修改代码本决定规则和少有镜头的例子. 在经过了人入人出,错误分析驱动的即时工程程序Cohn等 (2025)之后,编码本和即时经过多轮反复改进(QQ 10\相接10),修改的动机是审查LLM预测与人类判断之间的分歧. 每次修订都根据新提取的、不相连的搁置情况,而不是用于推动变革的项目来评估,从而减少过度调整注解办法或促使出现先前观察到的案件的风险。 这330个发展项目都没有出现在本文件中用于分析的最后裁定的人类参考资料集(不久讨论)中,保留了完全脱节的评价样本。 《补充材料》2 2 2 https://github.com/claytoncohn/LAK27_补充材料记录了由此产生的决定规则、实例和完善过程。

blocks.en: The remaining 3,524 items formed the sampling pool for the dataset used in this study. A preliminary LLM pass generated provisional failure-mode labels used solely for stratified sampling. We selected n = 100 n=100 localized segments for our adjudicated human reference set, intentionally over-sampling Conceptual Gap , Procedural Slip , and Operator Selection , which the preceding refinement process had identified as particularly difficult to distinguish. Because the reference set was designed to diagnose classification failures rather than estimate population prevalence, we prioritized representation of these challenging classes over preserving their natural corpus distribution. These provisional labels were used only for sample construction and therefore do not represent the final adjudicated class distribution (presented shortly).
blocks.zh: 其余3,524个物品构成本研究所用数据集的取样池。 初步LLM通过生成了仅用于分层取样的临时故障模式标签。 我们选择了 n = 100 n = 100 本地化部分作为我们裁定的人类参考, 有意对概念差距、程序滑行和操作员选择进行过度抽样, 由于该参考集旨在诊断分类失败,而不是估计人口流行率,我们优先考虑这些具有挑战性的类别的代表性,而不是保留其自然体分布。 这些临时标签仅用于样品构造,因此不代表最终裁定的分级分配(很快提交)。

blocks.en: We chose 100 transcripts as a bounded diagnostic reference set that remained feasible for full independent annotation and adjudication while supporting overall agreement estimates and exploratory class-level error analysis. This feasibility constraint was informed by the preceding codebook and prompt refinement process, during which two researchers familiar with the codebook collectively labeled more than 500 instances across overlapping subsets of the 330 development items over two weeks. They then independently applied the finalized codebook to the graded response in each of the 100 reference-set items (i.e., localized segments), recording a label and written justification. The dialogue context available for each reference-set item ranged from 2 to 133 turns ( M = 7.7 M=7.7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们选择了100份记录誊本作为一组有限度的诊断参考,这些记录和参考仍可用于完全独立的注释和裁定,同时支持总体协议估计数和探索性等级错误分析。 前面的编码本和迅速的完善过程为这种可行性制约提供了依据,在此期间,熟悉该编码本的两名研究人员在两周内对330个开发项目中相互重叠的子集加了500多个实例。 然后,他们独立地对100个参考集(即本地化部分)中的每个项目进行分级答复,记录标签和书面说明。 每个参考项目可用的对话上下文从2个到133个转弯(M=7.7个M=7.7个)不等。

blocks.en: The two raters completed their initial segment annotations independently before discussing disagreements. Initial inter-rater agreement was modest (Cohen’s κ = .588 \kappa=.588 ), with 29 items disputed. Following Thomas and others (2026) , we treated these disagreements as evidence about the analytic construct rather than annotation error, resolving disagreements through adjudication against the transcript and codebook. Adjudication was completed without access to the LLM classifications, preserving the independence of the reference labels from the model predictions, and required ≈ 90 \approx 90 minutes for the 29 disputed items. The resulting reference set comprised 45 Conceptual Gap (CON), 21 Not Applicable (NA), 14 Uncertainty (UNC), 8 Misattribution (MIS), 6 Procedural Slip (PROC), and 6 Operator Selection (OP) items. The final human-adjudicated distribution differs from the provisional LLM-based sampling allocation, including a greater number of items ultimately assigned to Conceptual Gap .
blocks.zh: 两位评定员在讨论分歧之前独立地完成了最初的分解说明. 最初的双方协议是适度的(Cohen's $ = 5.88\kappa= 5.88),有29个项目存在争议. 继托马斯和其他人(2026年)之后,我们把这些分歧作为分析结构的证据,而不是注释错误,通过对记录和密码本的裁决来解决分歧。 裁决完成时没有访问LLM分类,保留了参考标签与模型预测的独立性,29个有争议项目需要QQ 90\大约90分钟. 由此产生的参考资料包括45个概念空白(CON)、21个不适用(NA)、14个不确定性(UNC)、8个不当分配(MIS)、6个程序滑行(PROC)和6个操作员选择(OP)。 最后的人类判断分布不同于基于LLM的临时抽样分配,包括最终分配给概念差距的更多项目。

blocks.en: To contextualize our findings, we conducted semi-structured interviews (35–45 minutes) with three K–12 teachers and tutors (37, 16, and 12 years of teaching experience), who together teach (or have taught) a range of subjects including primary school mathematics, AP calculus, and language arts. Interviewees were presented the study’s findings via a slide deck and asked how these model errors might affect classroom practice and what risks might follow from providing the wrong type of feedback. This procedure was approved under an IRB exemption covering the collection and use of de-identified teacher and tutor quotations. Tutor interviews were recorded via Zoom under the IRB exemption described above and transcribed using Zoom’s automated transcription service. Transcripts were de-identified prior to analysis. The first author then reviewed the de-identified transcripts qualitatively to identify recurring perspectives, which are reported alongside representative quotations in Section 4 . All study artifacts, including the final annotation codebook, LLM prompts, the tutor interview slide deck, and additional procedural details, are provided in the Supplementary Materials.
blocks.zh: 为了根据实际情况分析调查结果,我们与三名K-12教师和辅导员(37、16和12年的教学经验)进行了半结构化的访谈(35-45分钟),他们共同讲授(或已经讲授)一系列科目,包括小学数学、AP微积分和语言艺术。 受访者通过滑行板介绍了研究的结果,并询问这些模型错误会如何影响课堂实践,提供错误的反馈可能带来何种风险。 这项程序在IRB豁免下获得批准,涉及收集和使用已取消身份的教师和辅导员引文。 根据上述IRB的豁免,通过Zoom记录了教师的面谈,并利用Zoom的自动抄录服务进行转录。 在分析之前,已删除了记录。 第一提交人随后从质量上审查了未鉴定的记录,以查明反复出现的观点,这些观点与第4节中有代表性的引文一起报告。 补充材料中提供了所有研究文物,包括最后注释编码本、LLM提示、辅导员面试幻灯片和补充程序细节。

blocks.en: 2.3 LLM Classification
blocks.zh: 2.3 LLM 语言 分类

blocks.en: Three LLMs, one from each of three major vendors, were evaluated via API: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Terra, Google’s Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5. Each model was selected from the corresponding vendor’s second-tier (termed “tier 2”) stable offering to support a comparable cross-vendor evaluation while keeping inference costs tractable; deliberately spanning vendors reduces (but does not eliminate) the risk that high LLM–LLM agreement merely reflects shared training data or architecture rather than genuine interpretive convergence. Each tier 2 model’s default reasoning setting (medium effort) was used. As a supplementary robustness check, we repeated the classification using Google’s Gemini 3.6 Flash (the highest-performing vendor’s top-performing model as of August 2026; termed “tier 1”) with the maximum available reasoning effort ( ≈ \approx 65k tokens) to assess whether increased model and reasoning capability altered the observed agreement pattern.
blocks.zh: 3个有限责任公司(3个主要供应商各1个)通过API进行了评价: OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Terra,谷歌的双子座3.5 Flash,和Anthropic的克洛德·奥普斯 5. 每个模式都从相应的供应商的二级(称为 " 第二级 " )稳定报价中挑选出来,以支持可比的交叉供应商评价,同时保持可推论成本;有意跨越供应商,减少(但并未消除)高水平的LLM-LLM协议仅仅反映共享培训数据或架构而不是真正解释性趋同的风险。 采用了第二级模型的默认推理设置(中等努力)。 作为补充性强度检查,我们重复了Google的双子座3.6 Flash(截至2026年8月销售商表现最出色的顶级模式;称为"第一级")的分类,并尽最大可能进行推理努力(\\\\\x65克令牌),以评估增加的模型和推理能力是否改变了所观察到的协议模式.

blocks.en: For all LLM runs, classifications used schema-constrained structured JSON outputs restricted to the six allowable labels and a three-run self-consistency majority vote per item. Each model received the full codebook, learning objective, task instructions, and all preceding dialogue within the localized segment up to the utterance in question. The fixed prompt included 17 expert-verified few-shot examples drawn from the development set and disjoint from the 100-item reference set. The codebook, prompts, few-shot examples, and voting procedure were then held constant across models.
blocks.zh: 在所有LLM运行中,分类使用受计划限制的结构化JSON输出,仅限于6个允许的标签和每件3个运行的自相容多数选票. 每个模式都收到完整的编码本、学习目标、任务指示以及所有先前在本地部分内进行的对话,直至相关言论。 固定的提示包括从开发集中取出17个经专家核实的少数镜头,与100项参考集脱节. 代码簿,提示,少拍的例子,投票程序,然后在模型之间保持了恒定.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.4 评价计量

blocks.en: Pairwise agreement between human and LLM raters and among LLMs is quantified using Cohen’s κ \kappa . We use κ = .70 \kappa=.70 as a pre-specified interpretive benchmark, following its use in prior learning analytics work on automated discourse annotation Liu et al. (2025) ; it is not treated as a universal threshold for validity or acceptance. Multi-rater agreement across all LLMs is assessed using Krippendorff’s α \alpha . For both statistics, Not Applicable (NA) is retained as a regular label (rather than excluded) because determining that the available evidence is insufficient to support any failure-mode diagnosis is itself a meaningful classification decision. Excluding NA cases would remove the instances needed to evaluate whether models appropriately refrain from diagnosing a failure mode when the transcript does not support one.
blocks.zh: 人类和LLM的测评人之间以及LLMs之间的对等协议, 我们使用ob =.70\kappa=.70作为预先规定的解释性基准,此前在自动化语句解析工作中使用了ob =.70\kappa=.70,刘等 (2025) ;它不被视为有效性或接受的普遍阈值. 使用Krippendorff的α-alpha来评估所有LLMs的多端协议。 对于这两种统计,不适用(NA)被保留为常规标签(而不是排除),因为确定现有证据不足以支持任何故障模式诊断本身就是一项有意义的分类决定。 将NA案件排除在外将消除评估模型是否适当避免在记录不支持失败模式时诊断失败模式所需的实例。

blocks.en: Per-class precision, recall, and macro-F1 identify which failure modes contribute most to LLM–human disagreement, aggregated across the three primary models. McNemar’s tests evaluate whether models and human raters differ systematically in their use of NA. Item-level bootstrap resampling (1,000 resamples) provides 95% confidence intervals for agreement estimates.
blocks.zh: 每类精度、回忆和宏F1确定哪些失败模式对LLM — — 人类的分歧贡献最大,这三种主要模式汇总在一起。 McNemar的测试评价模型和人类评分率在NA的使用上是否有系统性的差异. 项目级的靴子回放(1,000个回放)为协议估计提供了95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Agreement estimates across configurations, split into three blocks: human raters’ pre-consensus agreement (top), each model’s agreement with the human consensus (middle), and LLM–LLM agreement only (bottom). α \alpha replaces pairwise κ \kappa for the three-LLM comparison since it generalizes to more than two raters and is on the same 0–1 scale. The top two blocks cluster closely together, while the bottom block stands well apart—illustrating the central divergence this study examines.
blocks.zh: 图1:各种配置的协议估计,分为三个部分:人类评级人的事先共识协议(上),每个模型与人类共识的协议(中),以及仅LLM-LLM协议(下). α\alpha 取代对等的 $\kappa 用于三LLM 比较,因为它概括到两个以上的分数,并且是相同的 0–1 比例. 上两个区块紧密地组合在一起,而下个区块则相去甚远 -- -- 打破了本研究审查的中央分歧。

blocks.en: 3 Findings
blocks.zh: 3 调查结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Human–LLM Agreement
blocks.zh: 3.1 人类-LLM 协议

blocks.en: Gemini 3.5 Flash achieved the highest agreement with the human consensus ( κ = .597 \kappa=.597 , 95% CI [.464, .709]), followed by Claude Opus 5 ( κ = .559 \kappa=.559 , [.427, .685]) and GPT-5.6 Terra ( κ = .524 \kappa=.524 , [.385, .640]; Figure 1 , middle). The tier-1 robustness check with Gemini 3.6 Flash at maximum reasoning achieved κ = .594 \kappa=.594 (95% CI [.459, .711]), effectively matching Gemini 3.5 Flash. The human–LLM agreement gap persisted across vendors, model tiers, and reasoning settings, suggesting that it is not readily resolved by increasing model capability alone.
blocks.zh: 双子座3.5 Flash与人类共识达成最高一致(= 5.97\kappa= 5.97,95% CI [464, .709]),随后Claude Opus 5(= 5.59\kappa= 5.59, [427, 68.5])和GPT-5.6 Terra(= 5.24\kappa= 5.24, [385, 640]; 图1, 中间). 1级稳健性检查与双子座 3.6 Flash在所实现的最大推理为: = 5.94\kappa= 5.94 (95% CI [459, 711]),有效匹配双子座 3.5 Flash. 不同销售商、模型层级和推理环境之间的人与LLM协议差距依然存在,这表明单靠提高模型能力无法轻易解决。

blocks.en: No model’s point estimate reached the pre-specified κ = .70 \kappa=.70 benchmark: estimates ranged from .524 to .597 across the three primary models and remained at .594 for the higher-capability robustness condition, with substantially overlapping confidence intervals throughout. This LLM–human agreement was comparable in magnitude to the two human raters’ initial agreement ( κ = .588 \kappa=.588 ; Figure 1 , top), but contrasts sharply with inter-LLM agreement. We examine this divergence next.
blocks.zh: 没有模型的分数估计达到预先规定的=.70\kappa=.70基准:在三种主要模型中,估计值从524到597不等,在能力较强的条件下,估计值保持在594, 整个信任间隔相差很大。 这一LLM-人类协议在数量上与两个人类评分者的初始协议(UF = 5.88\kappa= 5.88;图1,上)相仿,但与LLM协议形成鲜明对比. 我们接下来审查这一分歧。

blocks.en: 3.2 LLM–LLM Agreement
blocks.zh: 3.2 LLM-LLM协议

blocks.en: Pairwise agreement among the three tier-2 LLMs (Figure 1 , bottom) was consistently higher than agreement between any individual model and the adjudicated human reference set. GPT-5.6 Terra and Gemini 3.5 Flash achieved κ = .781 \kappa=.781 , GPT-5.6 Terra and Claude Opus 5 κ = .770 \kappa=.770 , and Gemini 3.5 Flash and Claude Opus 5 κ = .755 \kappa=.755 . Agreement across all three LLMs was similarly high, with Krippendorff’s α = .769 \alpha=.769 (95% CI [.671, .854]). All LLM–LLM point estimates were substantially higher than any individual model’s agreement with the adjudicated human reference set, with slight confidence interval overlap.
blocks.zh: 三级至二级有限责任公司(图1,下行)之间的对等协议始终高于任何单个模式与裁定的人类参照标准之间的协议。 GPT-5.6 Terra和双子座 3.5 Flash 实现 = 781\kappa = 781,GPT-5.6 Terra和克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克勞德·克·克. 所有三个法学硕士协议同样高,Krippendorff的α=769\alpha=769(95%CI [671, 854])。 所有LLM-LLM点估计都大大高于任何单个模型对裁定的人类参考集的同意,信任间隔略有重叠。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : True (human consensus) vs. predicted class, pooled across the three tier-2 LLMs, row-normalized.
blocks.zh: 图2:真实(人类共识)与预测的类别,跨越三级至二级法学硕士,一行规范化。

blocks.en: This divergence constitutes the study’s central finding: the three models agree strongly with one another ( κ = .755 \kappa=.755 – .781 .781 ; α = .769 \alpha=.769 )—conventionally interpreted as substantial agreement Landis and Koch (1977) —despite only moderate agreement with the human consensus ( κ = .524 \kappa=.524 – .597 .597 ) on the same 100 items. Pooling the three models into a majority-vote label (i.e., the LLM consensus; Fonteles et al. (2026a) ) did not recover the human interpretation either: the LLM-consensus label agreed with the reference set at κ = .568 \kappa=.568 (95% CI [.430, .688]), no higher than the best individual model (Gemini 3.5 Flash, κ = .597 \kappa=.597 ). Cross-model consensus therefore does not indicate convergence on the human interpretation; here, it coexists with systematic disagreement about the inferred learner construct.
blocks.zh: 这一差异构成了研究的核心结论:三种模式彼此强烈同意(ob = 7.55\kappa = 7.755 — 7.81; α = 7.69\alpha = 7.69)——常规解释为实质性协议 Landis和 Koch (1977)——尽管与人类共识(ob = 524\kappa = 524 – 597.597)相同100项只有中度协议. 将三种型号合并为多数投票制的标签(即LLM共识;Fonteles等 (2026a))也没有恢复人文解释: LLM-共识标签同意了以 $ = 5.68\kappa= 5.68 (95% CI [.430,.688])为参考设定),不高于最佳个人型号(Gemini 3.5 Flash, = 5.97\kappa= 5.97). 因此,跨模式共识并不表明在人的解释上趋同;在这方面,它与对推定的学习者结构的系统性分歧共存。

blocks.en: LLM–LLM agreement exceeds the two human raters’ pre-adjudication agreement by .17–.19 kappa points, consistent with shared systematic bias: the models exhibit the same directional tendency in their class-level errors. Taken alone, the LLM–LLM agreement in Figure 1 could be mistaken for evidence of a reliable classification pipeline; relative to the human reference, it instead shows how cross-model consensus can overstate validity when models share the same errors. In practice, ensemble agreement should therefore be treated as evidence of consistency, not as a substitute for human validation of LLM labels.
blocks.zh: LLM-LLM协议超过两个人类评分前协议的17–19 kappa分,符合共享的系统性偏差:模型在等级错误中表现出相同的方向倾向. 光是图1中的LLM-LLM协议可能被误认为是可靠的分类管道的证据;相对于人类参考,它显示当模型有相同的错误时,跨模型共识如何可以过度描述有效性. 因此,在实践中,应把共同协议作为一致性的证据,而不是替代人类对LLM标签的验证。

blocks.en: 3.3 LLM Error Patterns
blocks.zh: 3.3 LLM 高压 错误模式

blocks.en: This shared bias is not random: it converges on a single class, Conceptual Gap (CON). Figure 2 illustrates this. For every non-CON row, the largest off-diagonal cell falls in the CON column. The matrix also reveals cross-class leakage beyond CON—for example, 10% of true NA instances are labeled MIS and another 10% are labeled OP.
blocks.zh: 这种共享的偏差不是随机的:它聚集在一个单一的类"概念差距"(CON)上. 图2说明了这一点。 对于每个非CON行,最大的离对角细胞会倒入CON列. 该矩阵还揭示了超出CON的跨级渗出——例如,10%的真实NA例被标记为MIS,另外10%被标记为OP.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Pooled tier-2 LLM predictions by reference class, ordered by macro-F1. Green indicates recall; P denotes precision. For every non-CON class, the most common error is misclassification as Conceptual Gap (red), indicating a shared directional bias.
blocks.zh: 图3:按参考类分类的集合二级LLM预测,由宏-F1排序. 绿色表示召回;P表示精确. 对于每一个非CON类,最常见的错误是错分类为概念差距(red),表示共同的方向偏差.

blocks.en: Pooling predictions from the three tier-2 LLMs reveals the same pattern in aggregate (Figure 3 ): for every non-CON class, the most common misclassification is Conceptual Gap . The effect is strongest for Procedural Slip , with 22% recall; 61% of true PROC instances are labeled CON, yielding the lowest class-level F1 ( F ​ 1 = .283 F1=.283 , n = 6 n=6 ). Because PROC and OP each contain only six human-reference items, these estimates should be interpreted as diagnostic evidence of error patterns rather than precise class performance estimates.
blocks.zh: 来自三级-2级法学硕士的集合预测显示的汇总模式相同(图3):对于每一个非CON类,最常见的错误分类是概念差距。 对程序滑动效果最强,召回22%;61%的真实的PROC实例被标为CON,得出最低等级的F1(F 1 = 2.283 F1 = 283,n = 6 n = 6). 由于ProC和OP各自只包含6个人类参考项目,这些估计应被解释为错误规律的诊断性证据,而不是精确的类性能估计.

blocks.en: Not Applicable (NA) exhibits a different but related failure pattern. NA predictions are relatively precise ( P = .867 P=.867 ) but have low recall (40%), with 35% of true NA instances instead classified as CON. All three LLMs assign NA substantially less often than the adjudicated human reference set (9–10% vs. 21% of items), with McNemar’s tests indicating statistically significant differences for each tier-2 LLM ( p ≤ .0098 p\leq.0098 ). In practice, the models more often infer a conceptual difficulty than conclude that the available evidence is insufficient for diagnosis. In one such item, the student correctly stated two intermediate division facts before the response was cut off mid-step (“6 divided by 2 is 3. 6 divided by 8—so we carry the 2…[unclear]”), leaving the final answer unrecoverable from the transcript; the human reference therefore withheld a diagnosis. All three LLMs nonetheless converged on Conceptual Gap , illustrating consensus despite insufficient evidence for any failure-mode diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 不适用(NA)显示不同的但相关的故障模式。 NA预测相对准确(P=867 P=867),但召回率较低(40%),35%的真实NA例被归类为CON. 所有三个LLMS都比裁定的人类参考数据集(9-10%对21%的项目)少得多,麦克内马尔的测试表明,每一级-2 LLM(p.0098 p\leq.0098)存在统计上的重大差异。 在实践中,模型更经常地推断出一个概念上的困难,而不是得出现有证据不足以诊断的结论. 在其中一项中,该学生在答复被截断( " 6除以2为3. 6除以8——所以我们承担了2...[不明]),使最后的答案无法从记录中恢复;因此,人类的参考没有诊断。 然而,所有三个法学硕士都集中在概念差距上,这表明,尽管没有足够证据证明任何失败模式诊断,但仍达成了共识。

blocks.en: Together, these patterns help explain the divergence between human–LLM and LLM–LLM agreement: models systematically over-attribute student difficulty to conceptual deficits, both when another failure mode is more appropriate and when no diagnosis is supported. These errors represent a shared directional bias rather than random noise that might average out across models. For learning analytics, such bias can systematically distort representations of learner difficulty.
blocks.zh: 这些模式加在一起,有助于解释人类-LLM和LLM-LLM协议之间的差异:模型系统地将学生的难度过度分配给概念缺陷,无论是在另一种失败模式更合适时还是在不支持诊断时。 这些错误代表了共同的方向偏差,而不是随机噪声,这些噪声可能在模型中平均出. 对于学习分析,这种偏差会系统地扭曲学习者难度的表述.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: This study demonstrates that cross-model agreement is not necessarily evidence of valid learner interpretation. Across three LLM families, models agreed more with each other than with the human consensus while sharing systematic directional errors. For learning analytics, LLM consensus can make annotation appear reliable while masking shared misinterpretation.
blocks.zh: 这项研究表明,跨模式协议不一定是有效学习者解释的证据。 在三个LLM家族中,模型相互之间比人类共识更一致,同时分享系统性的方向错误。 对于学习分析,LLM共识可以使注释看起来可靠而掩盖共同的误解.

blocks.en: 4.1 Validity of Learner Representations in Learning Analytics
blocks.zh: 4.1 学习者在学习分析中的代表性的有效性

blocks.en: Our findings point to a broader measurement problem in learning analytics: agreement among annotators, human or model-based, does not establish that learner representations validly capture the underlying construct. This is consistent with Thomas and others (2026) , who argue that inter-rater reliability should inform examination of disagreement and construct refinement rather than serve as a mechanical gatekeeper for ground truth. Similarly, Henkel et al. (2025) found that models remained highly consistent in formative literacy assessment even as model–human agreement declined. In our case, LLMs produced consistent representations of student difficulty that diverged substantially from human consensus.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果指出了在学习分析方面的一个更广泛的衡量问题:在人或模型基础上的注释者之间达成一致,并不能证明学习者的陈述能够有效反映基本结构。 这与托马斯等人(2026年)的观点是一致的,他们认为,在对分歧进行审查和构建完善时,应参考不同方之间的可靠性,而不是充当地面真相的机械守门员。 同样地,Henkel等人(2025年)发现,即使在模型-人类协议下降的情况下,模型在形成性扫盲评估中仍然高度一致。 就我们而言,法学硕士课程对学生的困难提出了一贯的表述,这与人类共识大相径庭。

blocks.en: 4.2 Instructional Consequences of Diagnostic Misclassification
blocks.zh: 4.2 诊断性分类错误的指令性后果

blocks.en: When diagnostic labels drive instructional responses, misclassification has direct pedagogical consequences. Automated tutoring systems use inferred error types to select targeted feedback and remediation McNichols et al. (2023) ; Reddig and others (2025) . Misclassifying a Procedural Slip as a Conceptual Gap , for example, can prompt feedback that treats an execution error as deficient understanding, despite evidence that responses to student errors should support motivation and build on what the learner actually knows Thomas and others (2023) . One interviewed tutor described the risk of internalized harm from repeated misdirected correction: “even if it’s that procedural slip… they’re gonna start to internalize some of that, like, I’m bad at math.”
blocks.zh: 当诊断标签驱动教学反应时,错误分类会产生直接的教学后果. 自动辅导系统使用推断出的错误类型来选择有针对性的反馈和补救McNichols等人(2023);Reddig等人(2025)。 例如,将程序滑动错误归类为概念差距,可以促进反馈,将执行错误视为理解不足,尽管有证据表明,对学生错误的反应应支持动机,并以学习者实际了解的托马斯和其他人(2023年)为基础。 一位接受采访的教师描述了反复错误地纠正造成的内化伤害的风险: " 即使是程序失误...... 他们将开始内化其中的一些,比如,我数学不好。 “

blocks.en: Conversely, misclassifying a genuine Conceptual Gap as a procedural slip can leave the underlying misconception insufficiently addressed, allowing it to persist Gurung and others (2023) . Diagnostic errors are therefore not interchangeable: different misclassifications can produce different instructional consequences—a point interviewed tutors raised independently of the pedagogical literature. As one observed, reteaching a skill that was never actually missing wastes instructional time: “if you’re reteaching something because something has been misdiagnosed as something else… you’re not moving forward…what was supposed to be a tool that helps teachers is now causing more pain and time.” Learning analytics systems should evaluate not only whether learner states are classified accurately, but also the consequences of acting on incorrect diagnoses.
blocks.zh: 相反地,将真正的概念差距错误地归类为程序失误,可能使潜在的误解得不到充分的解决,使Gurung和其他人(2023年)继续存在。 因此,诊断错误是不能互换的:不同的分类可能会产生不同的教学后果——一个与教学文献无关的受访教师所在的点。 正如有人所观察到的,重新教授一种从未真正错过的废物教学时间的技能:“如果你在重新教授某事,因为某事被误认为是别的事情...... 你没有前进... 原本是帮助教师的工具, 学习分析系统不仅应评估学习者状态是否得到准确的分类,还应评估对错误诊断采取行动的后果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Rethinking Traditional Discourse Annotation
blocks.zh: 4.3 反思传统演讲注释

blocks.en: The validity problem is not exclusively computational: disagreement among human annotators indicates that the underlying learner construct is itself difficult to infer from transcript evidence alone. This suggests that mutually exclusive failure-mode labels may impose sharper boundaries than the data support. Multi-label and uncertainty-aware annotation may better preserve cases in which several interpretations remain plausible.
blocks.zh: 有效性问题并不完全是计算问题:人类注释者之间的分歧表明,仅从笔录证据本身就很难推断潜在的学习者构造. 这表明相互排斥的失败模式标签可能会比数据支持强加更尖锐的界限. 多标签和对不确定性的认识说明可能更好地保留几种解释仍然合理的情况。

blocks.en: From an ICAP perspective, these exchanges provide observable evidence of constructive and interactive engagement, but our study highlights a complementary problem: even when discourse contains learning-relevant evidence, transforming that evidence into a diagnostic learner representation can introduce systematic measurement error. Transcript-only data also omit information available during tutoring, including prosody, written work, screen state, gestures, and other interaction traces. Some disagreement may therefore reflect missing evidence rather than deficient reasoning. Prior learning analytics work demonstrates the value of combining discourse with complementary trace data for contextualization Snyder and others (2024) , suggesting valid failure-mode diagnosis may benefit from multimodal evidence.
blocks.zh: 从会计师协会的角度来看,这些交流提供了建设性和互动性参与的可观察证据,但我们的研究突出了一个互补的问题:即使论述中包含与学习相关的证据,将证据转化为诊断性学习者代表可以引入系统性的衡量错误。 仅刻录的数据也省略了辅导期间可用的信息,包括活字,写作,屏幕状态,手势等互动痕迹. 因此,有些不同意见可能反映缺乏证据,而不是理由不足。 先前的学习分析工作表明,将论述与补充的微量数据结合起来对背景化Snyder和其他人(2024年)很有价值,这表明有效的失败模式诊断可能从多式联运证据中受益。

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: This exploratory study uses 100 deliberately sampled error moments from a single K–12 mathematics tutoring platform, limiting population-level and cross-domain generalizability; several classes also remain small. Practitioner perspectives were drawn from semi-structured discussions with three tutors rather than a systematic or representative stakeholder sample, and student perspectives were not collected. We also evaluate diagnostic validity rather than downstream consequences: the effects of failure mode misclassification on feedback, self-efficacy, misconception persistence, engagement, and learning remain unknown and should be examined alongside broader stakeholder perspectives. Future work should also consider larger reference sets, multimodal evidence, multi-label taxonomies, and uncertainty-aware inference; and should assess whether these findings generalize across platforms, subjects, and tutor and student populations.
blocks.zh: 这一探索性研究利用了100个从一个K-12数学辅导平台上刻意抽取出的错误瞬间,限制了人口水平和跨域的通俗性;一些课程也仍然很小. 实践者的观点是从与三名辅导员的半结构化讨论中得出的,而不是一个系统或有代表性的利益攸关方样本,学生的观点没有得到收集。 我们还评估诊断有效性,而不是下游后果:失败模式错误分类对反馈、自我效能、错误观念的持续存在、参与和学习的影响仍然不明朗,应当与更广泛的利益攸关方观点一起审查。 今后的工作还应考虑更大的参考资料、多模式证据、多标签分类法和对不确定性的认知推论;并应当评估这些结论是否贯穿各个平台、学科、教师和学生群体。

blocks.en: The central implication is nevertheless clear: before learning analytics asks whether LLM-generated diagnoses improve learning, it must establish that those diagnoses validly represent learner difficulty. When models share the same biases, consensus can increase confidence without increasing correctness. Agreement demonstrates consistency; validity requires evidence that the learner has been interpreted correctly.
blocks.zh: 然而,其核心含义是明确的:在学习分析学家问LLM生成的诊断是否改善学习之前,它必须确定这些诊断确实代表学习者的困难。 如果模型具有同样的偏差,协商一致可以增加信心而不会增加正确性。 协议表明一致性;有效性要求证明学习者得到正确解释。
